properties.name: Raskolnikov's Lodging
properties.description: A tiny garret on the fifth floor of a tall building on S. Lane. More like a cupboard than a dwelling. He has accumulated mounting debts to the landlady.

properties.name: Alyona's Apartment
properties.description: The fourth floor of a large apartment building near K. Bridge. The home of the old moneylender Alyona Ivanovna. A small room with yellow wallpaper where Lizaveta does the cleaning. It becomes the scene of the crime.

properties.name: Tavern
properties.description: An underground tavern near the Haymarket. The place where Raskolnikov drinks beer and first encounters Marmeladov. Dimly lit, reeking of cheap spirits.

properties.name: Marmeladov's Home
properties.description: The cramped apartment where the Marmeladov family lives. It depicts a household so degraded that Katerina is driven to violence against her husband.

properties.name: Haymarket (Sennaya Square)
properties.description: A market square in St. Petersburg. A district frequented by poor laborers and tradespeople. The place where Raskolnikov overhears by chance that Lizaveta will be away the following day.

properties.name: Streets of St. Petersburg
properties.description: The central districts of St. Petersburg in the blazing summer heat, lined with taverns and slums. The setting where Raskolnikov wanders deep in thought.

properties.name: Razumikhin's Home
properties.description: The dwelling of Raskolnikov's friend Razumikhin. Raskolnikov attempts to visit before carrying out his plan but thinks better of it and turns back.

properties.name: Sonya's Room
properties.description: A room in an old three-story building along a canal. The small room where Sonya lives. Raskolnikov visits her here, has her read from the Bible, and later confesses to the murders. Svidrigailov had been living in the adjacent room.

properties.name: Siberian Penal Colony
properties.description: The penal colony where Raskolnikov serves a nine-year sentence of hard labor. A small town near the Ob River. Sonya moves nearby, and it is here that the true regeneration of the two begins.
